title: Hom out of a finitely presented module commutes with flat base change
statement: Let $R\to R'$ be a flat ring map [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], $M$ a finitely presented $R$-module (the cokernel of an $R$-linear map $R^{\oplus m}\to R^{\oplus n}$) and $N$ any $R$-module. For an $R$-linear $h:M\to N$ let $\mathrm{id}_{R'}\otimes h:R'\otimes_RM\to R'\otimes_RN$ be its base change [def-weil-module-base-change] (written with $R'$ on the left). Then the $R'$-linear map $$\theta:R'\otimes_R\operatorname{Hom}_R(M,N)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_{R'}(R'\otimes_RM,\,R'\otimes_RN),\qquad r'\otimes h\longmapsto r'\cdot(\mathrm{id}_{R'}\otimes h)$$ is bijective. In particular this holds if $R$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $M$ is a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] (such an $M$ is finitely presented).

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma 087R (lemma-pseudo-coherence-and-base-change-ext, line 16709), part (1) and the final sentence ('if R is Noetherian and M is a finite module this holds')
